cohort: 120 neonates admitted to the Special Care Baby Unit (SCBU) of Nnamdi Azikiwe University Teaching Hospital Nnewi with clinical features suggestive of sepsis.
finding: Staphylococcus aureus was the most common bacteria isolated from neonates with blood culture-proven sepsis, and gram-positive bacteria were sensitive to gentamicin, vancomycin, and linezolid while gram-negative bacteria were sensitive to meropenem, imipenem, and ciprofloxacin.
